b.desc: A wise man once said "everyone loves bread". And he was right!
Bamboo isn't Wolf's favorite wood, but it's definitely on his top 5.
Do you like iced coffee? If so, check out the bar.
This beach camper actually belongs to Wolf, but he never drives it!
This is a great spot to forget time while reading a good book.
Softly shimmering with tradition. Upgraded with the Winter Sparkle event.
Need a cup of coffee? You can head on over to the brewery.
Craft some copper sheets and then "Cu" later!
The cotton weaver... weaves cotton. More specifically, cotton rolls.
Crafts milk. How a-moo-sing!
Makes a longcase clock, for all your watch needs.
A favorite spot for many lovebirds around the archipelago.
Breakfast is the most important meal of the day-and you can get it at the diner!
A fearless girl taking on the whole world! Obtain this by purchasing the International Woman's Day festival pass.
Crafts feed for your animals. They need food too, you know.
Feel the rhythm and join the celebration with music that keeps you dancing all night.
Grows wheat, daises, corn and carrots. How a-maize-ing!
These birds love to "fla-mingle" with each others! ...Yep, that was a bad one.
Rumor has it if you pass under here 3 times, you'll be married in a year.
Where all the islanders come to find the best gift to their loved ones.
Crafts one of Masaru's favorite meals: milk rice.
If you need an ingot, the foundry's got you.
A big, beautiful fountain. Doesn't it sound so relaxing?
This Gazebo's so romantic! Doesn't it make you all mushy inside?
Crafts cashmere and manure. These two don't usually go hand in hand, do they?
There's no Midas touch here, but at least you'll get some gold sheets.
There's no place like home!
There's no place like home!
The good old Townhall - It gives Bonuses to your Happiness and Population.
Mei sometimes picks a fight with the flowers. Nobody understands why.
This one is graceful AND does not try to come at you. Obtain it by purchasing the Winter Wonderland Festival Pass.
Ready for some music?
How often should you craft iron sheets? Periodically!
A kind of house that makes you want to quit your job and spend your days fishing.
A kind of house that makes you want to quit your job and spend your days fishing.
The good old Townhall - It gives Bonuses to your Happiness and Population.
An island shack where produce is expertly squeezed into refreshing juice.
What a majestic animal! It is so detailed that it could be scary though.
The place to Research both Production and Delivery.
Trade your Products for valuable Coins, XP and Materials.
Grows gold, copper and iron ore. Oh me, oh mine!
Crafts feathers and manure. Prepare yourself: those ostrich feathers are huge!
Keep palm and carry on!
This nursery is doing just "pine" when it comes to wood!
Grows coffee beans, cotton and silk cocoon, and it's all thanks to its sunny island.
Frogs love this "toadally" awesome spot. And so do the islanders!
Per the name, it grows rice.
Obtain Santa's Sleigh by purchasing the Winter Sparkle Festival Pass.
Crafts a very stylish poncho
For anyone with a horrible sense of direction.
Crafts silk bolts. How fancy!
Makes fertilizer so all of your trees can grow happy and healthy.
A lovely area to relax.
Only the fountain knows what the islanders wish for.
For the fashionista in you, it crafts cotton yarn and silk thread.
Legend has it this statue will sometimes move by itself. Spooky!
This lantern was built a long time ago, even before Mei arrived.
Perfect for any islander who feels like taking in the sun!
Sun's out, guns out! And what a better place to do that than the pool?
Is it getting chilly? The tailor can craft a jacket for you.
This is happy face! At least that's what the islanders believe.
Isn't this classical design so beautiful?
Well, it's a tree.
Don't forget to stop and smell the roses! Or, well, flowers.
From the moment you step inside, you'll feel like you're on vacation.
This bear family certainly has an unbreakable bond!
Don't be a square, have some fun in this rag top!
Where items go to hide from their responsibilities.
Crafts flour and ground coffee. And it's really big!
Makes gifts. (Not in the wiki yet – upgrade costs unknown.)
In the game simply called “Christmas Tree”. Decorate it by playing the Winter Sparkle event.
Nothing holding them in. They just didn’t want to leave.
Halloween event decoration. Grown with pure pumpkin magic.
Event decoration.
How scary that is! I hope it’s just a decoration and not really haunted!
It’s rare to find pine trees at the beach… so we decorated a palm tree instead!
There’s nothing better than a table where we can all come together and give thanks.
What better way to welcome the new year than with a festive sign?
A statue built with the bones dug up from the Triceratops!
A statue built with the bones dug up from the T-REX!

lex.t: Watching an advertisement for project grants more contribution. ¶ Ad contribution is when you watch an ad for a guild project, and this will contribute some points to the project.

At the Animal Shelter, you can feed your animals with Shelter Feed. In return you will get resources as reward after the animals have been working on it for a while. ¶ ## Stalls ¶ In the Stalls, you can select one of your aquired animals. Then feed it with Shelter Feed. It will start producing resources. ¶ There are 3 different time spans for how long time the animal will work until the resources are ready. 10 minutes, 2 hours and 6 hours. ¶ When you collect the resources, this will count as harvesting in guild projects. ¶ ## Collection ¶ In the collection you have an overview of all the animals you have, and also a shadow image of those you can get.

The Bakery is one of the first buildings you unlock in the game and you will be prompted to build it during the tutorial. ¶ This 6x6 building can be destroyed at any point during the game, you will be refunded 75% of the total coins spent on purchase and upgrades.
The Bamboo Nursery is a building on Jade Island, that produces Bamboo.
This 6x9 building can be destroyed at any point during the game, you will be refunded 75% of the total coins spent on purchase and upgrades. Materials used (hammers, nails) will not be refunded.
The Beach Camper is one of two current Gem Decorations available on Tropicalis Island. ¶ It ranks 2nd out of the 6 non limited time decorations that are available in the Housing Section.
The Bench is one of seven 3x3 decorations available on Haven Island. ¶ It ranks at 5th out of the 10 non limited time decorations that are available in the Housing Section.

The game has been around for one year already, and we celebrate this with the birthday event. ¶ The event area is located at the usual spot near the lighthouse on Haven island. ¶ You have to reach player level 11 to be able to take part.
Sunshine Island celebrates one year! ¶ This is a decoration that was reward for stage 25 in the process of baking the big birthday cake in the birthday event.

The Boat Yard is located on the fishing island right east of your main island. ¶ To enter the yard, you must drive the fishing boat close to it and click it to enter. ¶ Inside you can upgrade a bunch of stuff related to fishing. ¶ ## Lure capacity ¶ Increases the maximum amount of regular lures you can have. ¶ ## Hull upgrade ¶ Grants access to new fishing areas. Yellowfin Tuna and Tropicalis Triggerfish are more accessible in the new area accessed by increasing to level 2 and further east to the area extended by level 3.

Camille loves to help you find out new information while retaining her childish excitement. ¶ She has never met her father, which she's a bit curious about. Before meeting Rei, she was kind of lonely.

Celine scaled her life back when she got pregnant with Camille and became a single mother. ¶ Went to live on Tropicalis so Camille could be closer to her roots. ¶ Always working on new fashion designs.

The Christmas Tree is a limited time decoration that is available each year in the Winter Sparkle Event during December. ¶ Every Christmas, in the Winter Sparkle Event, you meet Santa by the event area on Haven island.

Help Ikaika run the Cacao Café and join the Cocoa Fever Event! Become a successful café manager, earn event currency, and grab all the rewards waiting for you in the Cocoa Fever Shop! ¶ Complete orders in Market, Seaplane, Ship and Floating Market to pick up Hot Cocoa.

Sunshine Island have an online Community Page where there are exclusive offers in addition to the offers that are available in game. ¶ Log in with your Community ID. This is located in your profile card in the game (in settings), right below your Personal ID. ¶ You can also grab a free daily offer in the form of a Mysterious Reward. ¶ The offers in the game will come with discounts up to 12% in the Community Page. ¶ The globe button in the game is a shortcut to the Community Page.

When purchasing a decoration, it only takes 5 seconds to build. ¶ ## Happiness ¶ Decorations are used to increase your overall happiness on each island. The happier the population of each island, the lower the production costs will be for goods on that island. ¶ When the Player Tournament is running, you can boost your score by placing down additional decorations. By clicking your happiness amount (found under your XP bar) you will be able to see what your current boost is. ¶ Decorations purchased with coins can not be upgraded.
The Decorative Bridge is one of two Gem Decoration available on Jade Island. ¶ It ranks 1st out of the 5 non limited time decorations that are available in the Housing Section.
She is often pulled into shenanigans without actually wanting to join. ¶ Personality: Defensive, Snarky, Impatient, Hardworking.

Diego likes to spread his love around, and is frequently used as comic relief due to that. ¶ He followed his mother to the archipelago since he wanted to take care of her. Became a pilot because his father was one.

The Diner is unlocked at level 21 and can be built on the Haven Island. ¶ This 3x6 building can be destroyed at any point during the game, you will be refunded 75% of the total coins spent on purchase and upgrades.
Lizzy shows up to help you do research, and is always ready to answer any questions. ¶ She decided to become a librarian after getting advice from a teacher during school.

## Q: What is Sunshine Island? ¶ A: Sunshine Island is an island-building tycoon game where you can turn your new home into a paradise. Harvest crops, craft products, play with your friends, team up with other islanders worldwide, and trade with the inhabitants! ¶ ## Q: On which platforms is SI available? ¶ A: Android via the Google Play Store, iOS via the Apple App Store and PC via the Microsoft Store. ¶ ## Q: How to contact Customer Service? ¶ A: The Customer Service can be contacted in-game via the settings wheel.
The Fearless Girl is a limited time decoration that was available in the International Woman's Day Festival Pass.

The Feed Mill is one of the first buildings you unlock in the game and you will be prompted to build it during the tutorial. ¶ It's recommended to upgrade this to keep up with the demand for feed (Cowshed, Ostrich Farm, Goat Farm and Animal Shelter).
The Festive Beats is a limited time decoration that was available in the Sunshine Birthday Bash Festival Pass.

Fields are one of the first buildings you unlock in the game and you will be prompted to build it during the tutorial. ¶ This 6x9 building can be destroyed at any point during the game, you will be refunded 75% of the total coins spent on purchase and upgrades.

The Fish Market is where you sell your fish. ¶ It is a boat anchored up to a tiny island just east of the Haven island. ¶ To enter the Fish Market, you must navigate your fishing boat close to the market, and click on the silver fish that appears above it. ¶ Select the fish you want to sell in the Inventory panel, then click Sell to get Sea Silver. Above the Inventory panel there are Missions.

Fishing allows you to sell fish for Sea Silver at the Fish Market. This in turn can be used to buy Mystery Boxes and other things in the Fishing Shop or use it for upgrades in the Boat Yard. ¶ ## How to fish ¶ To activate boat mode, locate the fishing boat, and click on it. Move the boat by swiping or tapping. You will see shadows of fish in the water; click the boat to activate fishing mode.
Get your rods and lures ready... It's fishing time! ¶ Catch Fishing Points and win rewards! Each time you catch a fish, you will earn Fishing Points, even if you release the fish.

Harry Carver will try his best to provide you with what you need. The fishing shop is similar to the Special Offers section in the game shop, just that in here every offer is costing Sea Silver. ¶ 2 of the offers will always be Mysterious reward boxes. The blue box can give any of the 6 material types. The green box can be anything from Coins or Gems to Products.
The Flamingo Pond is the highest ranked of the non-upgradeable decos available on Jade Island. ¶ It ranks 3rd out of the 5 non limited time decorations that are available in the Housing Section.

Floating Markets are one of 4 Trading Options in the game. Unlocked at level 30, this is another method of gathering Coins, XP and other Materials needed for Building, Upgrading and Researching. ¶ ## Boats ¶ There are 4 boats you can fill (Lotus Lantern, Jade Sparrow, Paper Crane, Drifting Cloud). Each boat has 3 rows of baskets you can fill, with 5 baskets on each row where each row asks for one type of product. Filling one basket will give you Coins and XP. If you do not have enough of one resource, you can use a Coupon or ask for help. ¶ A Reroll Coupon replaces a row with a different product.

The Flower Arch is the only current Loyalty Points Decoration available on Haven Island. ¶ It ranks 2nd out of the 10 non limited time decorations. Giving the most amount of Happiness possible on Haven Island without using Gems, it's recommended to upgrade this as soon as you can.
Flower Shop is a decoration that was given for free as a compensation for debuff of Loyalty Point decorations in May 2024.
The Flowerbed is one of seven 3x3 decorations available on Haven Island. ¶ It ranks at 10th out of the 10 non limited time decorations.
The Food Stand is a building on Jade Island, that produces Milk Rice and Bamboo Rice (Bamboo Rice unlocked at player level 46).

The Foundry is the only One time build type building on the Jade Island. ¶ It produces Ingot from Ore. The ingot can be used to produce metal sheets in the Forges. ¶ This 6x6 building can be destroyed at any point during the game, you will be refunded 75% of the total coins spent on the building (including building cost).
The Fountain is the only current 6x6 decoration available to buy on Haven Island. ¶ It ranks at 7th out of the 10 non limited time decorations.

Meet the islanders and make friends with them! ¶ This feature requires player level 21. ¶ Some of the islanders will appear around the islands. Find and interact with residents around the archipelago to build friendships.

Guilds are groups of players that work on projects together. Each guild consists of one leader, optionally one co-leader, any number of officers and members. ¶ After reaching level 12, you can join a guild by visiting the guild Island and clicking on the lighthouse there. ¶ You should make a good effort to find an active guild that suits your style of play.

The Guild Bank is where you can buy Guild Coins. It is located on the Guild Island. ¶ Guild Coins you buy become property of the guild you are currently member of. If you leave the guild, the coins stay with the guild.

Guild Coins are property of the Guild. No player personally owns any Guild Coins, even if they buy it in the Guild Bank. ¶ The Guild Coins are for upgrading Guild Buildings to increase different kind of bonus perks for the guild. Only the Leader (and Co-leader) can spend coins.
Increase the maximum number of members you can have in the guild.

Running projects with your guild is a core part of playing this game. ¶ Player can contribute to a project by harvesting the required resources while the project is running. Resources you already have in the warehouse or resources you get from offers in the shop do NOT count towards guild projects. ¶ Each player can also watch one video ad each to earn some additional points into the project.

The guild tournament takes place every third week (alternating between Guild, Player, and Cruise Tournaments). During this time, guilds compete against each other to earn points and climb up in the ranking. In order to get points, guilds need to complete projects.
It's the spooky season! ¶ Pumpkin Hunt and Haunted House: Collect Spooky Lanterns around the islands, and make Moonlit treats in the Magic Cauldron to decorate the Haunted House, and get rewards.

You will also meet him as the merchant in the Fishing Shop. ¶ This character loves spinning tall tales and pulling harmless pranks, always with a mischievous grin.

Houses are a vital part of every island, but don't go overboard with them as they will decrease your happiness! ¶ It's recommended to have as few houses as possible, levelled up as high as you can afford. This frees up vital space for other buildings. ¶ This 6x6 building can be destroyed at any point.

Smart Houses are one of the worst gem purchases in the game. You will only see a very small difference between this and a regular house. ¶ Upgrading will only cost Gems, not Hammers and Nails like normal house.

The Townhall is the heart of your Island. It is preloaded when you first start the game. ¶ Your Townhall is one of the most important buildings when it comes to increasing both your Happiness and Population. Keep it maxed out for your level.
